title: A synthetic week
description: One week of hourly flows, pressures, hourly exit-point nominations and bookings generated from the network model, with an unplanned outage at Kollsnes, reduced capacity on Langeled, recurring H2S and CO2 excursions at four fields and a pigging programme on every trunk, export line and interconnector. Synthetic: use it to see how live operations look, not as a record of real flows.
